quest.Name: The ruin that cleaves the sky
quest.Accomplishment: You secured the Heavenpiercer ruin for the Arcology of Ibul.
quest.Hagiograph: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= drove hostile forces from the ruin that cleft the sky.
quest.Gospel: In honour of the Arcology of Ibul, Quaestor =name= raised a tower that touched the heavens, to serve as their capital city in Qud. In thanks,the people of the frozen arcology <spice.history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random>.

step.Name: Return to the Magister
step.text: Return the the Magister and report your success.

quest.Name: The Wayward Hunter
quest.Hagiograph: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= stalked the jungles and slew the goatfolk shamans in their unholy fortress.
quest.Gospel: At the bloody Battle of the bloody grove, Moonchosen =name= slew the high chieftain of the goatfolk and liberated the people of the syzgy from captivity. In =player.t's= honour they <spice.history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random>.

step.Name: Slay the Goatfolk Gaoler
step.text: Claim the key to the Ekuemekiyyen's bonds from the corpse of the gaoler

step.Name: Recover the Goatfolk Gaoler's key
step.text: Claim the key to the Ekuemekiyyen's bonds from the corpse of the gaoler

step.Name: Free the Priest of the Moon
step.text: Speak to the imprisoned Priest of the Moon and use the key to free them from their bonds

step.Name: Return to high priest of the encampment
step.text: Return to the high priest and tell them the outcome of your raid

quest.Name: A demonstration in savagery
quest.Accomplishment: At the request of a goatfolk chieftain, You destroyed the Ekuemekiyyen encampment.
quest.Hagiograph: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= stalked the jungles and put the Ekuemekiyyens to the sword in their unholy fortress.
quest.Gospel: At the Battle of the bloody grove, =name= lead the armies of the goatfolk clans against the masked hunters of the jungle, and cracked the moon asunder. In =player.t's= honour they <spice.history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random>.

step.Name: Journey to the Ekuemekiyyen camp
step.text: Travel to the camp of the Ekuemekiyyens.

step.Name: Slay the commander of the Ekuemekiyyen encampment.
step.text: Slay the commander of the Ekuemekiyyen encampment.
